title: Security baseline: a host can decline one platform baseline contribution (e.g. storage's sys_attachment create) instead of wrapping contributePlatformBaselineSet
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ② a contract seam, surfaced by the 18.4 pin round in objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4415 (cloud#4384; dev report on cloud#4384 comment 6858526160). The consumer is cloud's control plane.

## 维护者速读

框架 18.4 把「上传附件」加进了每个成员的默认权限。cloud 的控制面是跨租户的，一直刻意不让组织管理员在控制面上创建附件。框架没有提供「宿主拒绝某一项默认权限」的开关，cloud 只好包装框架内部的一个函数来挡住它。框架以后改这个函数名，这层保护就会失效。这张卡请框架给宿主一个正式的开关。

## What happens

objectstack `fd6374713a` (#32932) puts storage's attachment set on every member's platform baseline. On cloud's control plane, the org-admin subject could then create `sys_attachment` rows on an object the control plane does not tenant-scope. Cloud now wraps the security service's `contributePlatformBaselineSet` seam, on the control plane only, and admits a create-bearing grant on its read-only objects as read only. The framework offers no host option for this. If the seam is renamed, the wrapper warns and stops withholding; cloud's tenant-wall test then goes red.

## Expected

A declared host option, for example a posture or config entry on the security service, by which a host declines, or downgrades to read, a named platform-baseline contribution for named objects. It must be evaluated where the baseline is assembled.

## Acceptance

A test host declines the attachment create through the option: the baseline grants read only, and a create is refused. Without the option, behaviour is unchanged.

Dedupe: `contributePlatformBaselineSet host opt-out`, `decline platform baseline`: no open issue.
